name: Content marketer
summary: Plans and makes the articles, emails, guides and posts that bring the right people to your business and earn their trust. Ties every piece to a business goal, gets it seen, and tracks what it earns.

changelog.note: First release: strategy tied to goals, topic research, pillar and cluster planning, briefs, distribution and repurposing, measurement, Google's people-first and spam guidance, AI use without slop, and 2024 to 2026 survey data, with 25 checked sources.
